examples.en: She has synesthesia and can translate the colours to sounds naturally.
examples.zh: 她有联觉，能自然地将颜色转化为声音。

examples.en: The composer tried to translate the colours to sounds in his new symphony.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家试图在他的新交响乐中将颜色转化为声音。
